archetypes.purpose: Optional high-level priors; archetypes never define fixed personas.

rows.label: Price-conscious Student
rows.description: Young consumer with high price resistance and strong peer exposure.

rows.label: Tech-savvy Value Professional
rows.description: Digital professional who pays for clear productivity/value.

rows.label: Premium Convenience Buyer
rows.description: Higher purchasing power and convenience sensitivity.

rows.label: Skeptical Researcher
rows.description: High evidence requirement and low trust in exaggerated claims.

rows.label: Social Trend Follower
rows.description: Socially influenced consumer responsive to popularity and advocacy.

rows.label: Practical Family Buyer
rows.description: Household value, trust, and reliability dominate.

rows.label: Early Adopter
rows.description: High novelty and technology adoption; useful for diffusion seeding.

compatibility_rules.purpose: Declarative starting rules for compatibility and correlations.

rows.label: Student income cap
rows.reason: Avoid unrealistic senior-level income for typical student profiles.

rows.label: Income lowers price sensitivity
rows.reason: Higher income generally reduces but does not eliminate price resistance.

rows.label: Stubbornness lowers susceptibility
rows.reason: Strongly stubborn agents should move less after conversation.

rows.label: Tech adoption raises AI familiarity
rows.reason: Highly digital consumers are unlikely to have near-zero AI familiarity.

rows.label: Privacy concern reduces AI trust
rows.reason: Privacy-sensitive consumers should be more cautious with AI products.

rows.label: Sociability supports influence
rows.reason: Highly social agents should not have negligible word-of-mouth reach.

consumer_behaviour.purpose: Consumer purchasing styles and research/brand tendencies.

rows.label: Heavy Researcher
rows.description: Compares alternatives before deciding.

rows.label: Brand Loyalist
rows.description: Prefers familiar brands and resists switching.

rows.label: Active Switcher
rows.description: Open to alternatives when value or novelty appears stronger.

rows.label: Convenience-first
rows.description: Prioritizes effort reduction and usability.

rows.label: Quality-first
rows.description: Willing to pay when perceived quality is compelling.

rows.label: Impulse Buyer
rows.description: Faster decisions with weaker research requirements.

decision_styles.purpose: Decision weighting profiles for product beliefs and purchase intent.

rows.label: Analytical Buyer
rows.description: Evidence-heavy, slower decision process.

rows.label: Value Buyer
rows.description: Compares benefit against price.

rows.label: Social Buyer
rows.description: Peer and social signals strongly affect decisions.

rows.label: Emotional Buyer
rows.description: Emotion and narrative can dominate rational comparison.

rows.label: Premium Decision Style
rows.description: Focuses on trust, quality, convenience, and status.

rows.label: Cautious Buyer
rows.description: Requires strong evidence and low perceived risk.

demographics.purpose: Demographic starting profiles; later calibratable to target-market data.

rows.label: Young Student
rows.description: College-age consumer with limited independent income and high peer exposure.

rows.label: Early Professional
rows.description: Early-career consumer with growing disposable income.

rows.label: Mid-Career Professional
rows.description: Established professional with stronger purchasing power and time constraints.

rows.label: Family Decision Maker
rows.description: Consumer whose purchases are influenced by household needs and shared budgets.

rows.label: Mature Value Buyer
rows.description: Experienced buyer with stronger value and trust considerations.

economic_traits.purpose: Economic decision profiles separate from raw income.

rows.label: Budget-constrained
rows.description: Strongly constrained by price and recurring cost.

rows.label: Value Seeker
rows.description: Pays when benefits clearly justify price.

rows.label: Balanced Spender
rows.description: Moderate price and value orientation.

rows.label: Convenience Spender
rows.description: Willing to pay more to save time or effort.

rows.label: Premium Buyer
rows.description: Low price resistance when trust/status/quality are high.

emotions.purpose: Emotional-response profiles for later conversation and event effects.

rows.label: Optimistic
rows.description: Interprets uncertain outcomes relatively positively.

rows.label: Cautious Emotional
rows.description: Sensitive to loss, risk, and safety cues.

rows.label: Excitable
rows.description: Strong response to novelty and enthusiastic word-of-mouth.

rows.label: Status-driven
rows.description: Sensitive to exclusivity, premium positioning, and visibility.

rows.label: Emotionally Stable
rows.description: Moderate emotional reactivity.

rows.label: Reactive / Resistant
rows.description: Can resist or push against high-pressure persuasion.

occupations.purpose: Occupation distribution and correlated income/technology ranges.

rows.label: Student
rows.description: Student or recent trainee.

rows.label: Software / Technology
rows.description: Technology professional with high digital familiarity.

rows.label: Business / Services
rows.description: Business, finance, consulting, or services worker.

rows.label: Healthcare
rows.description: Healthcare professional with strong evidence and trust concerns.

rows.label: Education
rows.description: Teacher, lecturer, academic, or education worker.

rows.label: Entrepreneur / Self-employed
rows.description: Variable-income, opportunity-oriented consumer.

rows.label: Government / Public Sector
rows.description: Public-sector employee with relatively stable income.

rows.label: Other Employed
rows.description: General employed consumer.

personality.purpose: Personality profiles used as distributions rather than fixed personas.

rows.label: Analytical
rows.description: Evidence-focused and comparison-oriented.

rows.label: Balanced
rows.description: Uses both rational and emotional cues.

rows.label: Emotion-led
rows.description: Strongly responds to emotional framing and social context.

rows.label: Cautious
rows.description: Risk-sensitive and slower to update beliefs.

rows.label: Adventurous
rows.description: Novelty-seeking and willing to try unfamiliar products.

rows.label: Skeptical
rows.description: Requires stronger evidence and resists persuasive claims.

social_behaviour.purpose: Social interaction traits used by scheduler and propagation models.

rows.label: Private / Independent
rows.description: Few conversations and low conformity.

rows.label: Normally Social
rows.description: Moderate interaction and influence.

rows.label: Peer-driven
rows.description: Strongly influenced by friends and local consensus.

rows.label: Family-oriented
rows.description: Household relationships dominate product discussion.

rows.label: Community Connector
rows.description: High-contact bridge consumer with stronger word-of-mouth reach.

rows.label: Trend Follower
rows.description: Highly sensitive to popularity and influencer signals.

rows.label: Low Digital Adoption
rows.description: Limited comfort with digital products.

rows.label: Mainstream Digital
rows.description: Comfortable with common digital services.

rows.label: Tech Savvy
rows.description: High digital literacy and product experimentation.

rows.label: AI Enthusiast
rows.description: Highly receptive to AI-enabled products.

rows.label: AI Skeptic
rows.description: Digitally capable but skeptical of AI claims and privacy.
